# TestScript for 29-feature-toggles — default posture and enforcement.
# With no configuration only the default-on gates are active: strict-tls and
# metrics. Gated flags and the gated command are invisible and unusable, while
# the baseline flags remain.

# Isolate the conventional XDG config tier from the host machine.
env HOME=$WORK/home
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg

# 1. Default help shows only active members: --quic and --allow-insecure are
#    gated off, as is the admin command.
exec feature-toggles --help
stdout '--listen'
stdout '--cache'
stdout '--feature-gates'
! stdout 'QUIC/HTTP3'
! stdout 'development only'
! stdout 'admin\s+Experimental admin API'

# 2. The default run reports the resolved configuration and feature state.
exec feature-toggles
stdout 'listen=:8080 cache=128 quic=false insecure=false'
stdout 'features: http3=false admin-api=false strict-tls=true metrics=true'
stdout 'metrics: collecting on :8080'

# 3. Invoking an inactive flag is a usage error (exit 2).
exit-status 2 feature-toggles --quic
stderr 'flag .--quic. requires feature "http3"'
exit-status 2 feature-toggles --allow-insecure
stderr 'flag .--allow-insecure. requires feature "!strict-tls"'

# 4. Invoking an inactive command is a usage error, even when asking for help.
exit-status 2 feature-toggles admin
stderr 'command "admin" requires feature "admin-api"'
exit-status 2 feature-toggles admin --help
stderr 'command "admin" requires feature "admin-api"'

# 5. --why reports only the active flags, plus the resolved feature state.
exec feature-toggles --why
stdout '--listen'
! stdout '--quic'
stdout 'Features:'
stdout 'http3'
stdout 'strict-tls'

# 6. Non-sensitive flag values display once tagged safe: no redaction footer.
exec feature-toggles --listen :9000 --cache 256 --why
stdout '--listen\s+:9000\s+cli'
stdout '--cache\s+256\s+cli'
! stdout '██████'
